title: Competitive Corporea
description: A data pack that aims to make corporea networks less gated to increase their competitiveness against digital storage mods.
body:
A data pack that aims to make corporea networks less gated to increase competitiveness against digital storage mods.

Adds new recipes for the coporea spark & master corporea spark. Removes the necessity to go to the end & create an elven portal to create a corporea spark network.

1 spark + 1 mana pearl + 1 bottle = 3 corporea sparks

1 corporea spark + 2 mana diamonds = 1 master corporea spark
